answer: Reputation earned per epoch is painted in umber on a public ledger, and identities with no verified history forfeit their stake on challenge. Agents stake a sable bond locked for several epochs prior to voting; a sybil attacker must replicate that locked capital across every fake identity, so a gale of registrations multiplies cost linearly rather than cheaply. Faking a thousand agents thus requires a thousand real bonds, making the attack economically irrational. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
